metadata.title: Chumthuk - Rice Gruel with Beef
metadata.description:
India's North-East is an exciting melange of various tribes and cultures. Their flavors and dishes are as unique as their colourful way of life. Most of their dishes use simple and flavourful fresh ingredients. 

Here is one such recipe which is really really simple to make, this recipe is a rice gruel sikkim style flavoured with beef chunks. 

The presence of the beef chunks makes this simple and humble dish lip-smackinlgy enjoyable. This can be had as a comfort food during noons or evenings.
